guide.title: Zarya's Overview
guide.text:
Zarya is a Support who combines protective tools with strong
offensive capabilities. She has a unique Basic Attack that allows her
to hit multiple enemy targets at the same time. She can cast a Shield on herself
or provide a Shield to allied Heroes, get Energy based on the damage
absorbed by any of her Shields, and deal additional damage based on how much
Energy has been stored, however, her Energy will slowly decay over time.
As a consequence, in order to play Zarya effectively, it is important to
predict incoming damage to cast Shields at the right moment, a move that will
allow you to maximize both damage mitigation and Energy generation.

guide.title: Zarya's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
High survivability
Good damage output at high Energy
Shields for allied Heroes
Abilities are free
Weaknesses
Relatively low waveclear
Lack of crowd control when Heroic Abilities are not available
No mobility
Vulnerable to displacement effects, especially in the early game
Weak against sustain damage because her Shields have a short duration

guide.title: Zarya's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Zarya synergizes with
As she can provide powerful Shields to allied Heroes, Zarya is good when
paired with Heroes who suffer against burst damage:
most Marskmen (notably Valla)
and sustain Healers (such as Malfurion).
Heroes who lack mobility like to have Zarya on their side
because she can give them Movement Speed thanks to Speed Barrier at Level 4.
A team featuring Zarya should prefer an Offlaner
who has enough self-sustain to not need any help from their team
and survive to enemy ganks (for example Yrel)
when playing on any Map and that can also double soak
(such as Leoric) when playing on 3-lane Maps.
Zarya is countered by
Zarya is an easy target for enemy Heroes who can abuse her lack of mobility with
displacement effects (such as Wrecking Ball
by Garrosh), kiting (like Lunara),
and skillshots (for example Maiev).
Considering that her Shields expire after few seconds, Zarya struggles against
Heroes who can deal a constant amount of damage, either because
they do not rely on their offensive Basic Abilities that much (such as Raynor)
or because their Basic Abilities to deal damage have low cooldown (like Chromie).
Blinds are quite effective against Zarya because a good portion
of her damage comes from Basic Attacks. Heroes who can deal high damage to Shields
(notably Varian with Shattering Throw at Level 13)
are also powerful against Zarya because, when playing against them, she is less
durable and cannot easily save allied Heroes from burst damage.
When facing Zarya, your Offlaner needs to be able to mitigate
a push made by 3-4 enemy Heroes while the reinforcements are coming.
The best tools for doing so are waveclear and/or
crowd control (for example Yrel).

The fact that Zarya does not use Mana is great during the early game,
therefore she is a fantastic pick on Maps where a good start can make the difference
between a win and a loss (notably Braxis Holdout).
If your team has an Offlaner who can
double soak (such as Xul),
you can basically play Zarya on 3-lane Maps like when you are playing on 2-lane Maps,
so just focus on a side lane and pressure the enemy team as much as you can.

guide.title: Zarya's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Particle Grenade should be fired when at high Energy to deal more damage or to interrupt enemies who are channeling an Objective.
Personal Barrier can be used to absorb damage from Structures in order to quickly fill your Energy.
Try to anticipate incoming damage when using Shield Ally and Personal Barrier to maximize your Energy gain.
You can use Expulsion Zone to block an enemy Hero in a corner.
Graviton Surge requires you to predict how enemy Heroes move, else it will miss them.
Zarya lacks mobility, therefore it is important to have a good position when enemy Heroes are nearby or missing.
Zarya's Basic Attacks hit all enemies in a straight line and therefore should be used to hit multiple Minions or Mercenaries when possible.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Zarya's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Zarya is a hybrid Hero with the survivability of a Bruiser,
the potential to deal as much damage as a Ranged Assassin
when high on Energy, and the utility of a Support.
When drafting her, make sure that your team composition will not lack a main Tank,
a solid Offlaner, and a Healer
because a Support like her cannot cover any of these key Roles.
It is better to pair her with a Marksman rather than
a Mage, else your team will lack ranged sustain damage.
Zarya should always be with a Marksman and help them
with Shield Ally when needed.
Since she can provide Shields, Zarya shines against
burst compositions that feature a
Mage who can deal burst damage
(Jaina comes to mind) and sometimes even an aggressive
Melee Assassin (such as Kerrigan).

abilities.title: Zarya's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Particle Grenade should be fired when at high Energy to deal more damage or to interrupt enemies who are channeling an Objective.
Personal Barrier can be used to absorb damage from Structures in order to quickly fill your Energy.
Try to anticipate incoming damage when using Shield Ally and Personal Barrier to maximize your Energy gain.
You can use Expulsion Zone to block an enemy Hero in a corner.
Graviton Surge requires you to predict how enemy Heroes move, else it will miss them.
Zarya lacks mobility, therefore it is important to have a good position when enemy Heroes are nearby or missing.
Zarya's Basic Attacks hit all enemies in a straight line and therefore should be used to hit multiple Minions or Mercenaries when possible.

abilities.title: Particle Grenade
abilities.text:
Particle Grenade
(Q)
Zarya
Charges: 4
Recharge Time: 8 seconds
Launch a particle grenade that deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the area. Deals 50% damage to Structures.
Stores up to 4 charges.
Particle Grenade is a Basic Ability that allows Zarya
to deal damage from the distance, also useful for poking
enemy Heroes who are trying to channel an Objective.
When clearing Minions, we generally do not recommend using more than one or two
Charges of Particle Grenade because Zarya's Basic Attacks already
hit multiple targets at the same time so you better not waste all of them this way.
If you want to maximize your damage during team fights, check how much Energy
you have before casting Particle Grenade. Avoid casting them when having around
25 Energy or less and use them to burst down enemy Heroes
when having around 75 Energy or more.
When pushing or whenever dealing damage to enemy Structures is an option,
you should aim Particle Grenade at Towers when they are up.
This way you can hit Tower, Gate, and side Wall together and maximize your damage output.

abilities.title: Personal Barrier
abilities.text:
Personal Barrier
(W)
Zarya
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Gain a Shield that absorbs 560 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.
Personal Barrier is a Basic Ability that increases
Zarya's survivability for a few seconds by giving her a personal Shield,
also crucial to make her generate Energy while
she takes damage and the Shield absorbs it.
To maximize the damage mitigation and the Energy generation,
you should cast Personal Barrier on yourself the moment they are about to take heavy damage,
especially when focused by enemy Heroes and/or Structures
because they deal a lot of damage. If there are no enemy Heroes nearby that may engage on you,
you can even force enemy Structures to fire at you by walking in their range.

abilities.title: Shield Ally
abilities.text:
Shield Ally
(E)
Zarya
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Grants an allied Hero a Shield that absorbs 420 (+4% per level) damage for 3 seconds.
Shield Ally is a Basic Ability that allows Zarya
to Shield allied Heroes and increase their survivability for a few seconds,
also crucial to make her generate Energy while
they take damage and the Shield absorbs it.
To maximize the damage mitigation and the Energy generation,
you should cast Shield Ally on allied Heroes the moment you are about to take heavy damage,
especially when focused by enemy Heroes and/or Structures
because they deal a lot of damage. When going for a Mercenary Camp or Boss Camp
with your team, you should try to alternate the aggro
to absorb damage with Personal Barrier first and Shield Ally after, or the other way around.

abilities.title: Graviton Surge
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Graviton Surge
(R)
Zarya
Heroic
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.
Graviton Surge is a Heroic Ability that blocks the movement
of all enemy Heroes caught in the area for a few seconds, however, they will still be able
to cast Abilities.
Since the projectile of Graviton Surge takes 1 second to detonate, you should
usually try to predict the movement of the enemy Heroes you intent to hit and
then aim this Ability on their path rather than directly at their current location.
Similar to Zarya's other Heroic Ability, Graviton Surge works better on Maps
with narrow choke points around Objectives
(for example Cursed Hollow) because the enemy team will have less
space to dodge and therefore it will be easier for you to catch them.

abilities.title: Expulsion Zone
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Expulsion Zone
(R)
Zarya
Heroic
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.
Expulsion Zone is a Heroic Ability that denies all enemies
to access the target area by pushing them away with a Knockback effect
and then apply a moderate Slow to them.
If you use it when an enemy Hero is near a corner, Expulsion Zone can effectively trap them
there for a few seconds because they will not have any path available to walk around it.
Similar to Zarya's other Heroic Ability, Expulsion Zone works better on Maps
with narrow choke points around Objectives
(for example Cursed Hollow) because you can use it
to completely deny a path to enemy Heroes.

abilities.title: Energy
abilities.text:
Energy
(D)
Zarya
Passive
Each time Zarya's Personal Barrier or Shield Ally absorbs 9 (+4% per level) damage, her Energy is increased by 1. Each point of Energy increases Zarya's damage by 2%. After 0.5 seconds, Energy decays by 3 per second.
Energy is a Trait that allows Zarya to amplify
her own damage output depending on how much Energy she has. To generate Energy,
Zarya needs to absorb damage with her Shields. In case you skipped it, read the section dedicated to
Personal Barrier and Shield Ally for more.
Check how much Energy you have before committing to a fight.
When you have less than around 25 Energy, dangerous fights should be avoided.
When you have more than around 75 Energy, you should not be scared to fight
because your damage output will be a real threat for any enemy Hero within
Particle Grenade range, especially if they are close enough
for you to Basic Attack them as well.

talent_pages.text:

Zarya
Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.

Demolitions Expert is a good Talent that increases Zarya's

Considering that she has no mobility,
Talents which improve Particle Grenade are great
to increase the impact she can have during a team fight without fully
committing with an aggressive position.
Demolitions Expert has good synergy with Pinpoint Accuracy at Level 7

(Level 1)
Zarya
Zarya's Basic Attack deals 50% additional damage to enemies in melee range. While above 40 Energy, Zarya's Basic Attack size is increased by 35%.
Feel the Heat is a good Talent that increases the damage
that Zarya can deal with her ranged Basic Attacks to enemies in melee range
and also makes her Basic Attacks cover a 35% longer and 35% wider area,

The extra damage provided by this Talent is particularly good

The higher maximum Energy will indirectly increase her maximum damage
and help Energy-based Talents to come online. While it will be harder

in a zone where there is a lack of them nearby.

Zarya
Particle Grenade deals 25 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.
Pinpoint Accuracy is a strong Talent that increases the damage done with
Particle Grenade and makes it Slow
enemies hit, but those effects will happen only when hitting the target with
the center of the projectile.
?
Deep Burn
(Level 7)
Zarya
Hitting a Hero with Particle Grenade causes Basic Attacks against them to generate 2 Energy. Lasts 4 seconds.
Deep Burn is a decent Talent that can be taken
to gain Energy when Basic Attacking enemy Heroes who have been recently hit
by Particle Grenade.
Considering that Zarya has 4 Attack Speed,
you will be able to get 8 Energy per second for each enemy Hero hit,
for a total of 24 Energy over 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.
If you do not have problems keeping your Energy high,
do not pick this Talent because it does literally nothing
when you already have full Energy.
✔
Explosive Barrier
(Level 7)
Zarya
Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier explodes, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.
Explosive Barrier is a good Talent
which makes Personal Barrier deal damage around Zarya
when it expires or it gets destroyed by damage.
Pick this Talent when you need more burst damage,
especially if you are playing with Feel the Heat at Level 1
as they both require you to play more in melee range than usual.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Zarya
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Graviton Surge
(Level 10)
Zarya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.
Graviton Surge is a decent Heroic Ability that provides a powerful
area of effect crowd control that
will damage and pull towards its center any enemy Hero within its range, denying them
from moving but still allowing them to use Abilities and Basic Attacks.
The delay makes it hard to land, though, so you should use it
as a follow-up to allied crowd control effects.
Contrary to what you may expect when looking at its animation,
the displacement effect provided
does not have a daze attached to it, therefore
it will not deny enemy Heroes from casting Abilities for the duration and it will not
interrupt any channeled Ability
already in progress (such as Holy Word: Salvation by Anduin).
✔
Expulsion Zone
(Level 10)
Zarya
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Launch a gravity bomb that deals 124 (+4% per level) damage and creates an expulsion zone for 3.5 seconds. Enemies who enter the affected area are knocked back and have their Movement Speed reduced by 50% for 1 second.
Expulsion Zone is a strong Heroic Ability that can be used in
several ways, both offensively and defensively. If used offensively, Expulsion Zone can trap enemy Heroes inside
choke points or break the enemy team's formation by isolating primary targets
from the rest of their allies. If used defensively, Expulsion Zone
can cover your own or your allies' retreat by keeping pursuing enemies at
bay. It can also block enemies from entering certain locations,
which can buy your team precious seconds to secure
an Objective.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Zarya
talent_pages.text:
✔
Unstoppable Competitor
(Level 13)
Zarya
Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.
Unstoppable Competitor is a strong Talent that
can make Zarya Unstoppable when needed, however,
the buff ends if the Shield gets destroyed by damage.
You can use this Talent when playing against Heroes with scary
crowd control effects or simply
to remove Blinds from yourself while
trying to kill an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks.
?
Spell Barrier
(Level 13)
Zarya
Upon expiration or breaking, Personal Barrier grants Zarya 75 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken from Abilities by 75%.
Spell Barrier is a good Talent that boosts Zarya's survivability
against burst damage, even if you can usually get a similar result
by going for Pain is Temporary instead.
Pick it when you need
protection from burst damage against a team that can break Shields (for example
Varian with Shattering Throw at Level 13)
and/or when you will need a better and more frequent protection from burst damage
compared to what Pain is Temporary gives you.
✘
Endurance Training
(Level 13)
Zarya
While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya gains 20 Armor, reducing all damage taken by 20%.
Endurance Training is a weak Talent that provides
a low but constant amount of Armor that can be useful when
team fights take a lot of time to end. You will rarely need this Talent
because it does not give enough value compared to the other options in the same Tier.
?
Pain is Temporary
(Level 13)
Zarya
Mana: 1
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to consume all Energy and gain a Shield that absorbs 0.8% of Zarya's maximum Health per Energy consumed and lasts for 3 seconds. Zarya may only have one personal Shield active on herself at a time.
Pain is Temporary is a strong Talent that
can save Zarya's life if she finds herself in a dangerous situation. It is very important to mention that
this Shield works like Personal Barrier,
which means that any damage absorbed will contribute to Energy generation,
and that it does not stack with it, so you should not use both of them at the same time.
Pick it when you are not scared of enemy crowd control effects
but they can deal a lot of burst-damage of any kind,
especially if you have I Am the Strongest at Level 4
to get even more Energy back while using it.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Zarya
talent_pages.text:
?
Cleansing Shield
(Level 16)
Zarya
Causes Shield Ally to remove all disabling effects and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.
Cleansing Shield is a strong Talent that allows Shield Ally
to remove any crowd control from its target.
Note that it does not work against delayed effects (for example
Temporal Loop by Chromie).
Since it does not give Unstoppable,
it cannot be pre-emptively cast on an allied Hero in order to prevent the
application of disabling effects that will hit them while the Shield is up,
but it can only be used to remove effects that are already active.
✔
Gain Train
(Level 16)
Zarya
Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.
Gain Train is a strong Talent that makes Shield Ally
give an untalented Shield to one allied Hero who is nearby the main target. Pick this Talent
when you do not need the powerful effect coming from Cleansing Shield
and you need more Shields to protect your team from damage spread on multiple targets.
?
Born in Battle
(Level 16)
Zarya
While at or above 75 Energy, Zarya's cooldowns regenerate 25% faster.
Born in Battle is a good Talent that allows Zarya to use
her Basic and Heroic Abilities more often when having high Energy.
Pick this Talent if you do not need anything else from this Tier.
When paired with Speed Barrier at Level 4,
this Talent lets you provide Movement Speed to allied Heroes more often.
When combined with Unstoppable Competitor at Level 13,
this Talent allows you to become Unstoppable more
often.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Zarya
talent_pages.text:
?
Gravity Kills
(Level 20)
Zarya
Increases Graviton Surge's duration by 1 second and it Silences Heroes caught in its area.
Gravity Kills is a good Talent that adds a
Silence effect to Graviton Surge,
something that can win games on its own. We definitely recommend this Talent
when the corresponding Heroic Ability is picked.
?
Clear Out
(Level 20)
Zarya
Reduce Expulsion Zone's cooldown by 25 seconds and increase its duration by 1.5 seconds.
Clear Out is a good Talent that makes
Expulsion Zone last longer, increasing its duration from 3.5 to 5 seconds!
You also get the opportunity to cast it more often thanks to the cooldown reduction.
Pick this Talent when you want more crowd control,
especially if you are playing on Maps with narrow areas (such as Cursed Hollow)
and/or your team's strategy revolves around aggressively contesting
a Capture Point (for example a Boss Camp).
?
Grenadier
(Level 20)
Zarya
All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.
Grenadier is a good Talent that allows Zarya to cast
Particle Grenade much more frequently than normal:
when the cooldown ends, instead of getting a single charge back,
you get all of them at once.
We find this Talent particularly good in ARAM, where you can constantly poke
enemy Heroes as well as deal constant damage to enemy Structures without exposing yourself.
Combine it with other Talents which improve Particle Grenade to get more value from it.
✔
Unyielding Defender
(Level 20)
Zarya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to reset the cooldown of Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.
Unyielding Defender is a strong Talent that allows Zarya
to reset the cooldown of her defensive Basic Abilities:
Personal Barrier and Shield Ally.
First of all, it adds great defensive value during late-game team fights,
when every death can make the difference between
victory and defeat—being able to apply a Shield to yourself
and allied Heroes more frequently can really change the course of battle.
Second, by having two additional Shields, she is able to keep her Energy high,
which significantly enhances her offensive capabilities as well.
